commits.comment: 重构 AMD MIR 调度 DAG 的生成方式：原先通过 `-stop-before=machine-scheduler` 转储 MIR 文本再重新解析成新的 MachineFunction 来构建 DAG（遗留 TODO），现改为在 live codegen pipeline 上直接构建。实现上让 EmitSchedulingDAGPass 通过 `substitutePass(&MachineSchedulerID, &EmitSchedulingDAGPass::ID)` 顶替 machine scheduler 的槽位，并以 `-stop-after=<livePipelineDAGPassName()>` 截断 pipeline，同时新增 arm/disarm 接口在 translateLLVMIRToMIR 中配对使用。原因是重解析后 MIR parser 按读取顺序给基本块编号（即 layout position），与 MIR printer 输出的 `bb.N`（原始编号）不一致时会导致 `region <bb>` 错键（如 gfx1250 fp16 matmul 中 710 个节点有 41 个错键），造成下游错误重排。此外 buildSchedGraph 会清除子寄存器 def 的 `undef` 位（期望调度器重新添加），在 live MF 上无法恢复，故新增 snapshot/restore 逻辑。风险点：新增的全局 sink 是进程级、非线程安全（需靠 arm/disarm 配对），且通过 RegisterTargetPassConfigCallback 懒注册来避免静态初始化顺序竞争。整体是修复真实正确性 bug 的 refactor，测试新增了 DAG 与 MIR 块号一致性交叉校验。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更位于 python/src/llvm.cc 的 translateLLVMIRToMIR 与 third_party/amd/lib/Target/MIRDAG/*，均为 AMD MIR 转储与调度 DAG 生成的 NVIDIA/AMD 专属路径，Ascend 走 TritonToLinalg 不使用 MIR DAG，也不调用 translate_to_mir。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。新增测试在 python/test/backend/test_mir_stage.py（AMD MIR 专属），Ascend 不运行该测试。

commits.message:
[AMD] Build the scheduling DAG on the live codegen MachineFunction (#12058)

`translate_to_mir` dumped MIR with `-stop-before=machine-scheduler`,
then
re-parsed that text into a fresh `MachineFunction` to build the
scheduling DAG.
This emits the DAG from the pipeline's own `MachineFunction` instead,
resolving
the `TODO` left in `DAGBuilder.cpp` by #11251.

## Why

Besides dropping the round-trip and reusing the `LiveIntervals` the
pipeline
already computed, this fixes a real mis-keying bug.

The DAG keys instruction identity on `(bb, pos)`, so a consumer resolves
`region <bb>` against the `bb.N` labels in the MIR dumped beside it. But
the MIR
parser numbers blocks in the order it reads them, so on a re-parsed
function that
number is the block's **layout position**, not its original number. The
two agree
only when layout order happens to match numbering.

It does not always match. A plain fp16 matmul on gfx1250 lays its tail
out as
`... bb.73 bb.76 bb.74 bb.75`, and the DAG published `bb.74`'s
dependencies under
the name `region 75` and `bb.75`'s under `region 76` — 41 of 710 nodes
keyed to
the wrong block. A consumer reordering on that information is reordering
against
another block's constraints.

Emitting from the live function keys on the same `MachineBasicBlock` the
MIR
printer labels, so the two cannot diverge.

## How

The pass takes the machine scheduler's slot via `substitutePass`, and
the
pipeline stops after it.

`insertPass(&MachineSchedulerID, ...)` does not work here:
`-stop-before=machine-scheduler` sets `Stopped`, so
`TargetPassConfig::addPass`
takes its `delete P` branch and silently drops anything inserted at that
anchor.
Anchoring on `RenameIndependentSubregs` instead would place the pass
ahead of
AMDGPU's own `GCNRewritePartialRegUses` insertion, which rewrites
instructions —
the DAG would then describe a different function than the one dumped.
Substituting runs the pass at exactly the point `MachineScheduler` would
have,
with the same `LiveIntervals`, and it preserves all analyses.

One subtlety: building the DAG perturbs the function. `buildSchedGraph`
clears
`undef` on subregister defs, expecting the scheduler to re-add it as it
places
instructions. Nothing restores it when we only build the graph, and a
subregister def that loses `undef` makes the dumped MIR unparseable
("Use not
jointly dominated by defs"). That was harmless while the function was a
throwaway re-parse. The pass now snapshots those flags and restores
them.

[AMD] Run the MIR-stage tests in AMD CI (#12080)

python/test/backend/ is not referenced by any workflow, so nothing in
test_mir_stage.py runs in CI.

The file already skips itself when the active backend is not HIP.
commits.comment: （自动判定）仅涉及 tests / docs / CI / 平台特化代码变更，不影响 triton-ascend。

GSan 影子锁性能优化：由于 PTX 16 位原子指令实际由 ptxas 模拟，改用原生 32 位原子。ShadowCell 中原先分开的 `uint16_t numReads` 与 `uint16_t lock` 合并为单个 `uint32_t readCountAndLock`，lock 取 bit 16（kLockBit），读计数取低 16 位（kReadCountMask）。acquireShadow 从 CAS 循环改为 `fetch_or(kLockBit)`，releaseShadow 改为 `fetch_and(~kLockBit)`，recordRead 用 RELAXED atomic load+store 更新计数（仅锁持有者改计数）。结构体大小仍为 24 字节（static_assert 保持不变），gsan_testing.cc 相应提取掩码。属于正确性保持的性能改进，注意 recordRead 使用原子 store 而非非原子自增是因为 waiter 会并发 OR lock bit。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更位于 python/triton/experimental/gsan/src/*（GSan 是 NVIDIA 侧内存 sanitizer，基于 CUDA 的 __scoped_atomic_* 内建），Ascend 不启用 GSan。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。gsan_testing.cc 的改动仅同步字段访问，属 GSan 专属测试支撑。

commits.message:
[GSan] Use 32-bit atomics for shadow lock (#12078)

It turns out that despite ptx having 16 bit atomic instructions, these
are actually emulated in ptxas.

This changes the locking to use native 32-bit atomic instructions,
giving a 1.4x speedup in a matmul benchmark running under gsan.

[AMD] Add initial GFX1250-strict Support (#11945)

Currently there is no support for gfx1250-strict in triton compiler,
which is missing some instructions available in nonstrict gfx1250. This
PR intends to cover that by implementing restrictions for
TargetFeatures, including Block16Convert instructions, parsing allowance
for "gfx1250-strict" instead of just "gfx1250".

commits.message:
[AMD] Launch the MIR-stage subprocess tests with sys.executable (#12062)

Five tests spawn a child interpreter as subprocess.run(["python", ...]).
That only works where a "python" executable happens to be on PATH -- in
a venv, say. On a bare image with just /usr/bin/python3 it raises
FileNotFoundError before the test does anything.

Use sys.executable so the child is the interpreter running the test,
which is also what makes the child inherit the right environment.

commits.comment: 测试基础设施改进：test_mir_stage.py 的 _find_llc() 增加在 Triton 自身下载的预编译 LLVM 包中查找 llc（glob $TRITON_HOME/.triton/llvm/*/bin/llc），并置于 shutil.which("llc")（PATH）之前。原因是原逻辑只查 LLVM_SYSPATH/LLVM_BUILD_DIR/PATH：无 llc 则最强 DAG 交叉校验被静默跳过；有 llc 则可能是比 Triton 构建所用 LLVM 落后多个大版本的发行版 llc，DAG 不可比。预编译包携带匹配的 llc 且 CI 已缓存，使交叉校验可在裸 CI 镜像上运行。纯测试改动，无产品代码影响。

commits.message:
[AMD] Find llc in Triton's own LLVM package for the DAG cross-check (#12064)

test_dag_matches_llvm compares the scheduling DAG we emit against the
one llc prints, but it only looked for llc via LLVM_SYSPATH,
LLVM_BUILD_DIR, or PATH. Neither variable is set on a bare CI image, and
both outcomes from there are bad:

- with no llc on PATH the test skips, so the strongest check that the
DAG is right quietly stops running;
- with a distribution llc on PATH it runs against that, which can be
many major versions behind the LLVM Triton was built against.

Search the prebuilt LLVM package Triton downloads as well. It carries a
matching llc and CI already caches it, so the cross-check runs there.
Search it ahead of PATH so a stray system llc stays a last resort.

commits.comment: 单行一致性 bugfix：python/triton/testing.py 的 get_max_simd_tflops 中 `torch.cuda.get_device_capability()` 改为 `torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)`。函数入口已从入参或 torch.cuda.current_device() 解析出 device 并正确传给 get_device_properties，但获取 compute capability 时未传 device。单 GPU 上 current 与 resolved 相同故不可见；多 GPU 且显式传入与 current 不同的 device 时，会把一个 GPU 的 multiprocessor_count 与另一个 GPU 的 compute capability 混用，导致 ops_per_sub_core 分支判断（capability[0]<8）错误，从而静默给出错误 TFLOPS 估算。sibling 函数 get_max_tensorcore_tflops 已正确传 device，本次修复使其对齐。属正确性修复，风险低。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更位于 python/triton/testing.py，属于基于 torch.cuda 的 NVIDIA BFLOPS/TFLOPS 估算辅助（使用 torch.cuda.get_device_capability），不涉及 BaseBackend/DriverBase/GPUTarget/code_generator/compiler.parse 等 Ascend 依赖的接口，Ascend 无 CUDA compute capability 概念也不调用该路径。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。该修复由现有/多 GPU CI 覆盖，与 Ascend 测试无关。

Fix device capability retrieval in testing.py (#12071)

New contributor declaration

[x] I am not making a trivial change, such as fixing a typo in a
comment.

[x] I have written a PR description following these rules
(https://cbea.ms/git-commit/#why-not-how).

[ ] I have run pre-commit run --from-ref origin/main --to-ref HEAD.
(Not run — I don't have the actual Triton repo checked out in this
environment, so I can't verify this against the real pre-commit config.
Please run this yourself before merging.)

Select one of the following.
[ ] I have added tests.
[x] This PR does not need a test because it's a one-line consistency fix
restoring an existing call-site pattern (passing device to
torch.cuda.get_device_capability) that the sibling function
get_max_tensorcore_tflops already uses correctly; a regression test
would require a multi-GPU CI runner with GPUs of different compute
capabilities to actually exercise the divergent-device code path.

Select one of the following.
[x] I have not added any lit tests.
[ ] The lit tests I have added follow these best practices
(https://mlir.llvm.org/getting_started/TestingGuide/#filecheck-best-practices).

Description

get_max_simd_tflops resolves device from the caller (or
torch.cuda.current_device() as a fallback) and correctly passes it to
get_device_properties(device), but calls
torch.cuda.get_device_capability() with no argument — always reading the
currently active device's compute capability instead of the resolved
device. On a single-GPU machine this is invisible since "current" and
"resolved" coincide. On a multi-GPU machine, calling this with an
explicit device that differs from the current one mixes one GPU's
multiprocessor count with another GPU's compute-capability generation,
which decides the ops_per_sub_core branch — producing a silently wrong
TFLOPS estimate. The sibling function get_max_tensorcore_tflops,
structured identically just above it in the same file, passes device
through correctly.

Additional information

Diff:

num_subcores =
driver.active.utils.get_device_properties(device)["multiprocessor_count"]
* 4
capability = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
capability = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)
if capability[0] < 8:
